resources.string: Keeps in touch with your loco server.

Lets loco control the device when you open the remote screen from the portal: tap, scroll, go back, and type text into the focused field. Nothing is read or sent outside a session you opened from the portal.
The device will be removed from this server and the agent will stop. You can enroll it again later.
Enroll this device on your loco server. Enter the address and key shown on the portal\'s Enrollment page.
Enter an https address and a key.
Server unreachable. Check the address and the network.
Compare this fingerprint with the one shown by the loco portal. Confirm only if it matches.
loco shows this screen during a session opened from the portal. Android displays the sharing indicator while it is active.
Lets the portal tap, scroll, go back and type. Without it, the screen stays visible only.
Lets the portal browse, download and upload your files.
